description: BCRR – BARRAGEM is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). A classe Barragem faz parte da categoria Hidrografia da Base Cartográfica do Estado de Roraima. A base cartográfica do Estado de Roraima, parceria entre o IBGE e Secretaria de Planejamento e Desenvolvimento do Estado de Roraima – SEPLAN, foi gerada a partir de integração de folhas do mapeamento existente nas escalas 1:100.000 e 1:250.000 e ... Coverage: the State of Roraima. Its tags are Roraima, Base Cartográfica. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
